steps.code:
# Compute most common genre per playlist and update titles
from collections import Counter

for p in all_playlists:
    playlist_id = p['playlist_id']
    original_title = p['title']
    song_ids = p['song_ids']
    genres = [song_genres[sid] for sid in song_ids]
    genre_counts = Counter(genres)
    # Most common genre (if tie, Counter.most_common(1) picks first encountered, which is fine)
    most_common_genre = genre_counts.most_common(1)[0][0]
    new_title = f"{original_title} | {most_common_genre}"
    print(f"Updating playlist {playlist_id}: '{original_title}' -> '{new_title}'")
    result = apis.spotify.update_playlist(
        playlist_id=playlist_id,
        access_token=access_token,
        title=new_title
    )
    print(result)
